title: What's new in AL and Tools (2026 release wave 2)

features.name: AL MCP (AL Management Control Platform)
features.description: AI agents can now search the connected environment to discover which app owns each object, its version, and can spin up workspaces on demand to find available object IDs in custom ranges.
caveats: Requires MCP configuration in copilot
Only searches remote environment, not workspace before connected

features.name: AL language server with project awareness
features.description: New project-aware language intelligence delivered over Language Server Protocol (LSP), no longer tied to Visual Studio Code, enabling code intelligence in any editor that supports LSP.
caveats: Requires LSP configuration in development environment

features.name: Symbol search with environment source parameter
features.description: AL symbol search now accepts a new 'source' parameter that can be set to 'environment', allowing search of symbols in the connected remote server without downloading symbols or creating dependencies.
caveats: Only works with connected environment
Must have environment access

features.name: Get next object ID tool in AL MCP
features.description: New MCP tool that examines app.json to determine what object ID ranges are defined and available, suggesting the next free ID based on current project state.
caveats: Depends on correct app.json configuration
Only suggests next available within defined ranges

features.name: Interface default implementations
features.description: Interfaces can now have default method implementations, allowing extension of interfaces with new methods without breaking existing consumer implementations. New methods get RequiredPending attribute to signal future mandatory implementation.
caveats: RequiredPending attribute signals breaking change in future major version

features.name: Public resource folders
features.description: Partners can now mark resource folders as public, making them accessible to other apps without a dependency on the providing app, while private resources remain internal.
caveats: Attempting to access private resources by app ID returns error
Breaking if provider stops shipping resource
Consuming apps must handle errors for missing resources

features.name: Big integer field type migration
features.description: Fields can be changed from integer to big integer type to handle sequences that exceed 32-bit integer limits. Requires careful migration with explicit conversion handling and attention to type conversions and potential overflow in dependent code.
caveats: Implicit conversion warnings when big integer values are assigned to integer fields
Risk of runtime overflow if dependent apps have not migrated their types
AppSource COP comparison against previous version shows compatibility breaks
AppSource COP reports implicit conversions as warnings
Integer overflow possible at runtime in dependent code
Requires careful review of all usages of the field

features.name: Namespace support in translation IDs
features.description: Translation files now support fully qualified namespace-based keys instead of hash-based keys derived from object names, eliminating collision risks when multiple objects share the same name in different namespaces.
caveats: Requires XL-file regeneration when namespacing existing objects

features.name: Mixed extension and base field SQL indexes
features.description: Ability to create SQL indexes that combine base table fields with extension fields for improved query performance when filtering or sorting by extension columns alongside base fields.
caveats: Requires explicit SQL configuration during extension development

features.name: Action tooltip inheritance from page
features.description: Actions can now inherit their tooltip from the page's ToolTip property instead of requiring a separate ToolTipML field, reducing duplication and simplifying maintenance across multiple actions using the same page.

features.name: Audit name fields as system fields
features.description: Created By, Created By Full Name, Modified By, and Modified By Full Name are now available as customizable system fields on records, alongside the existing grwits fields, providing readable audit identity without custom implementations.
caveats: Previously only rendered in the client; now customizable

features.name: Record.IsDirty() method
features.description: New method on record and record ref types to test whether a record has unsaved changes, replacing manual field-by-field comparison and enabling conditional save logic.

features.name: Data-driven testing framework
features.description: New test source pattern allowing a single test method to iterate over reusable data rows covering multiple scenarios (overdue, not overdue, rounding, etc.) without code duplication, returning structured JSON with pass/fail/skip counts and proper exit codes.
caveats: Requires test data source enum and test case initialization

features.name: Test handler interface for lifecycle hooks
features.description: Test handler enum pattern providing hooks at test codeunit and individual test procedure level: OnBeforeTestCodeunitRun, OnAfterTestCodeunitRun, OnBeforeTestProcedureRun, OnAfterTestProcedureRun, OnBeforeTestCaseRun, OnAfterTestCaseRun, with default implementations and per-codeunit overrides.
caveats: Supports both codeunit-specific and global default test handler implementations

features.name: Static call graph analysis
features.description: New agentic tool in AL.NET that performs offline static analysis to extract and query call chains across an extension and its dependencies, identifying all callers of a method and public entry points that should be reviewed when internal code changes.
caveats: Requires advance extraction step that compiles specified apps and builds dependency tree
Complementary to LSP which analyzes live project state; this tool works offline on extracted data
Output can be compared between versions to detect new or removed callers
Requires offline extraction of information beforehand
Can be cumbersome to set up initially

features.name: Agent-assisted production investigation
features.description: Coding agents can now capture performance profiles and snapshot recordings themselves through dedicated MCP tools without requiring an active debugging session, helping to investigate issues that only appear in specific customer environments.
caveats: Developer must judge the evidence and determine meaning
Requires agent framework to use

features.name: Launch profiling MCP proxy
features.description: New MCP proxy command in the al.net tool that allows agents to start and monitor profiling with parameters like environment, speed, and monitoring capabilities, automating the profiling workflow.
caveats: Requires agent framework to invoke
Developer must evaluate results

features.name: Launch snapshot MCP proxy
features.description: MCP proxy tool that enables agents to capture snapshot recordings on a specific environment and tenant, allowing agents to gather information about user interactions and identify bottlenecks or errors.
caveats: Fewer parameters than profiling tool
Server-side operation only

features.name: Isolated storage explicit read isolation level
features.description: Read isolation is now an explicit option when reading from isolated storage, allowing developers to specify read committed with an update lock isolation level rather than leaving it implied.
